language.name: English
menu.title: MAIN MENU
menu.scan.description: Inspects your PC without changing anything and reports what needs your attention.
menu.maintenance.description: Pick a category and then the exact action to run. Categories are grouped by what you want to achieve: clean your disk, speed up your PC or manage your apps. Nothing runs unless you choose it.
menu.settings.description: Change how Caduceus behaves, or reopen it as administrator. Your choices are saved for the next time.
menu.restart_admin.description:
Opens Caduceus again with administrator rights and closes this console. Windows asks you to confirm first, and if you decline nothing changes. Needed for the options marked [ADMIN].
• Windows · shows its own confirmation window
• This console · closed if started from cmd or PowerShell
maintenance.title: MANUAL MAINTENANCE
maintenance.cleanup.description: Frees up disk space by removing leftovers: temporary files, logs, caches, the Recycle Bin, restore points and old Windows files. It also holds the hibernation switch, which reserves a large file on your disk. Each option can run on its own, or you can run the fast or the full cleanup in one go.
cleanup.title: DISK CLEANUP
cleanup.temp_files.description:
Removes temporary files that Windows and programs leave behind. Anything modified in the last {cleanup_age} h is kept, and files in use are skipped. Windows rebuilds Prefetch, so the first launch of each program may be slightly slower.
• User · %TEMP% folder
• Windows · C:\Windows\Temp
• Startup · Prefetch (.pf files)
cleanup.hidden_junk.description:
Removes hidden files that Windows builds up in the background. Folders with pictures may open slower once, icons may redraw while they are rebuilt, and past crash reports are lost.
• Explorer · thumbnail and icon caches
• Reports · Windows error reports (WER)
• Dumps · crash, memory and kernel dumps
cleanup.components.description:
Frees space from the Windows component store and from Windows Defender. It takes minutes, cannot be cancelled once started and may ask for a restart. You can still uninstall updates, and the gain is not estimated.
• Updates · components left by old updates (WinSxS)
• Defender · logs and scan cache (quarantine is kept)
• Fonts · font cache (Windows rebuilds it)
cleanup.windows_old.description:
Deletes the previous Windows installation with the Windows Disk Cleanup. It can free many GB, but you can no longer go back to the previous version of Windows. It asks for confirmation first and cannot be cancelled once started. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• Installation · C:\Windows.old
cleanup.windows_old.confirm: This permanently deletes the previous Windows installation (C:\Windows.old). You will no longer be able to go back to the previous version of Windows, and this cannot be undone. Once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
cleanup.fast.description: Like RUN ALL CLEANUPS, but skips the slow ones (Windows components and Windows.old). Starts straight away, without asking for confirmation (Safe mode ON still skips the actions it blocks). Cannot be cancelled once started. Like RUN ALL CLEANUPS, it empties the Recycle Bin for good and force-closes open apps (Discord, Slack, Teams, Spotify and similar) first: save what you are doing.
cleanup.all.description: Runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other, and shows the result of each. It always asks for confirmation, even with Safe mode ON (which skips the actions it blocks). Cannot be cancelled once started and can take several minutes. All the consequences above apply.
cleanup.all.confirm:
This runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other.
Once it starts it CANNOT be cancelled, and it can take several minutes.
The Recycle Bin is emptied for good: deleted items cannot be restored.
With Safe mode OFF, the restore points are deleted too and Windows.old as well: you can no longer go back with a restore point or to the previous version of Windows.
Parts of it need administrator.
Open apps (Discord, Slack, Teams, Spotify and similar) are force-closed first: save what you are doing.
cleanup.recycle_bin.description:
Permanently empties the Recycle Bin of every fixed drive. Deleted items cannot be restored afterwards.
• Drives · C:\, D:\ and any other fixed drive
components.step: Cleaning the Windows component store (this can take several minutes)
windows_old.step: Deleting Windows.old (this can take several minutes)
closing_apps.step: Closing the apps that are open
result.admin: Run Caduceus as administrator to clean:
notice.nothing_selectable: Nothing here can be changed right now. Turn Safe mode OFF in Settings, or restart as administrator.
settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.safe_mode.description:
When ON, blocks the actions that cannot be undone and put the system at risk. Opens the options to switch it ON or OFF. ON is recommended. Saved between sessions.
• Blocked · Windows.old, restore points, hibernation, startup services, scheduled tasks that are not updaters, uninstalling drivers and runtimes
confirm.title: ARE YOU SURE?
confirm.skipped: Skipped (Safe mode is ON, or it needs administrator):
notice.settings_not_saved: Could not save the setting. It applies until Caduceus closes.
maintenance.performance.description: Helps your PC start faster and use less memory, which matters most for gamers and low-RAM machines. You can control what starts with Windows, as programs and as scheduled tasks. Nothing is deleted: everything you switch OFF can be switched ON again.
cleanup.windows_logs.description:
Removes Windows maintenance and setup logs. Logs from the last {log_age} h are kept, so there is still something to diagnose problems with.
• Servicing · CBS, DISM, Windows Update logs
• Setup · Panther and setupapi logs
cleanup.system_caches.description:
Removes cached update downloads, shader files and other Windows caches. Games may stutter briefly while shaders are rebuilt. Windows may download pending updates again.
• Updates · Windows Update, Delivery Optimization
• Graphics · DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD shader caches
• Windows · Microsoft Store, Windows Search, INetCache, etc.
• Drivers · NVIDIA and AMD installer leftovers
cleanup.browser_caches.description:
Removes the caches of your web browsers, from every profile. Cookies, passwords, history and extensions are never touched. Pages load slower the first time, and web apps that work offline may need to download their data again. Close the browsers first to free more.
• Chromium · Chrome, Edge, Brave, etc.
• Opera · Opera, Opera GX
• Firefox · every profile
• Contents · pages, code, shaders, etc.
cleanup.app_caches.description:
Removes the caches of apps you use every day. Accounts, messages, notes, settings and downloaded songs and installed games are never touched, and apps that are not installed are ignored. Open chat, work and media apps are force-closed first, so save what you are doing. Code editors, Steam and Epic are never closed. Apps open slower the first time.
• Chat · Discord, Slack, Teams, Signal, etc.
• Work · Notion, Obsidian, Figma
• Dev · VS Code, Cursor, Postman, GitHub Desktop
• Media · Spotify, Adobe (media cache)
• Cloud · OneDrive, Google Drive (logs only)
• Games · Steam, Epic Games, Ubisoft Connect, etc.
cleanup.developer_caches.description:
Removes the package caches of your development tools. Your projects, node_modules and .nuget\packages are not touched. Packages are downloaded again on the next build or install, which fails without network.
• JavaScript · npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, etc.
• Testing · Playwright, Cypress, etc. (they download again)
• Python · pip, uv, Poetry
• PHP · Composer
• .NET · NuGet, Visual Studio
• Java · Gradle
• Systems · Cargo, Go, Dart
• Games · Unity, Unreal Engine (rebuilding can be slow)
• IDE · JetBrains (projects are indexed again)
cleanup.restore_points.description:
Deletes all restore points and Shadow Copies of the system drive. It can free many GB, but you can no longer go back with a restore point or recover earlier versions of files. It asks for confirmation first and cannot be cancelled once started. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• Restore · system restore points
• Files · Shadow Copies (previous versions)
cleanup.restore_points.confirm: This permanently deletes ALL the restore points and Shadow Copies of the system drive. You will no longer be able to restore Windows to an earlier point or recover earlier versions of files, and this cannot be undone. Once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
performance.title: PERFORMANCE
performance.startup.description:
Shows the programs that start with Windows, how much memory each one uses right now, and lets you turn each one off or on again. Turning one off only stops it from starting with Windows: it stays installed and nothing is deleted. Services (security, VPN, drivers, databases) can only be changed with Safe mode OFF, and are skipped by the cursor while it is ON.
• Impact · estimated from the memory in use now
• ENTER · switches the selected program ON or OFF
performance.tasks.description:
Shows the scheduled tasks that run when Windows starts or when you sign in (many updaters start this way) and lets you turn each one off or on again. Turning one off only disables the task: it is not deleted. Tasks that are not updaters (security, VPN, drivers) can only be changed with Safe mode OFF, and are skipped by the cursor while it is ON.
• Microsoft · Windows' own tasks are not listed
• Runs at · Logon or Startup
cleanup.hibernation.description:
Shows whether hibernation is ON or OFF and opens the options to switch it. It is a system setting rather than a cleanup, but it frees one of the largest files on the disk, and it can be switched back ON at any time. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• OFF · frees the space Windows reserves for it
• ON · reserves that space again
cleanup.hibernation.title: HIBERNATION
cleanup.hibernation.off.description:
Turns hibernation off with the official Windows command (powercfg /hibernate off) and frees the space Windows reserves for it. Fast Startup is turned off too. It asks for confirmation first. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• Hibernation · hiberfil.sys (about 40% of RAM)
• Startup · Fast Startup depends on it
cleanup.hibernation.on.description:
Turns hibernation on with the official Windows command (powercfg /hibernate on). Windows reserves disk space for it again, and Fast Startup becomes available. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• Hibernation · hiberfil.sys (about 40% of RAM)
cleanup.hibernation.confirm: This turns off hibernation and deletes C:\hiberfil.sys. Fast Startup is turned off too, so Windows may start more slowly, and you can no longer hibernate. To undo it, run powercfg /hibernate on as administrator.
restore_points.step: Deleting the restore points (this can take a while)
startup.title: STARTUP PROGRAMS
tasks.title: SCHEDULED TASKS
tasks.none.description: No tasks are set to run when Windows starts or when you sign in.
startup.none.description: Windows has no programs registered to start with it.
notice.restart_cancelled: Windows did not give administrator rights, so Caduceus was not restarted.
maintenance.apps.description: Looks after the programs and apps installed on your PC: uninstall them, update them all in one go, repair or reset the ones from the Microsoft Store, and tidy the Open with menu. Nothing runs unless you choose it.
apps.title: MANAGE APPS
apps.uninstall.description:
Shows the programs installed on your PC, with the space each one says it takes, and lets you uninstall them with their own uninstaller. Windows components and updates are not listed. Drivers and runtimes can only be uninstalled with Safe mode OFF, and are skipped by the cursor while it is ON.
• Size · as registered by each program (— when unknown)
• ENTER · opens the uninstaller, after you confirm
apps.update.description:
Lists the apps that have a newer version, with the one installed and the latest, and updates the ones you choose, one at a time or all together. It uses winget (the Windows package manager), so it only knows the apps winget can find. Each update runs silently, and some installers ask for administrator rights on their own. Open apps may be closed to be updated, so save what you are doing first.
• Current · the version installed now
• Latest · the version winget can install
• ENTER · updates the selected app, or all of them
apps.update.title: UPDATE APPS
apps.update_all.description: Updates every app in the list, one after the other, with the same silent update as choosing them one by one. The result lists what was updated and what failed. It can take a long time.
apps.update.none.description: winget found no apps to update, or it is not available on this PC. It comes with Windows 10 and 11 through the App Installer, which you can install or update from the Microsoft Store.
apps.repair.description:
Shows the Microsoft Store apps installed for you and repairs the one you choose by registering it again from its own files. It fixes an app that stopped opening or lost its Start menu entry. Your data and settings are not touched, and the app is not reinstalled. System apps are not listed.
• Version · as installed
• ENTER · repairs the selected app
store.repair.title: REPAIR STORE APPS
apps.reset.description:
Shows the Microsoft Store apps installed for you and resets the one you choose: its local data and settings are deleted and it goes back to the state it had when installed, but it is not uninstalled. It asks for confirmation first. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
• Deleted · accounts signed in, settings and local files of that app
• Kept · the app itself
store.reset.title: RESET STORE APPS
store.reset.confirm: This deletes the local data and settings of the app above (you will be signed out of it and anything it kept only on this PC is lost). The app stays installed. This cannot be undone.
store.none.description: Windows lists no Microsoft Store apps for you that can be repaired or reset.
apps.open_with.description:
Removes from the Open with menu the apps that no longer exist, so it stops offering programs you uninstalled. It only touches your own registry (no administrator needed), and saves a backup (.reg) of everything it changes in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Caduceus\removed-entries first.
• Removed · apps registered for you whose file is gone
• Kept · every app that is still installed
notice.open_with_clean: There are no leftover apps in the Open with menu.
programs.title: UNINSTALL APPS
settings.safe_mode.title: SAFE MODE
settings.safe_mode.on.description:
Blocks the actions that cannot be undone and put the system at risk. Recommended: they stay dimmed in the lists and the cursor skips them.
• Blocked · Windows.old, restore points, hibernation, startup services, scheduled tasks that are not updaters, uninstalling drivers and runtimes
settings.safe_mode.off.description: Lets you run the actions that Safe mode blocks. Some cannot be undone, so each one still asks for confirmation first. Saved between sessions.
programs.none.description: Windows has no programs registered that can be uninstalled.
programs.confirm:
This opens the uninstaller of the program above. Caduceus cannot undo it: to get the program back you must install it again.
Caduceus waits until the uninstaller closes, and nothing else can be done meanwhile.
programs.stale.confirm:
The uninstaller of this program and the folder it was installed in no longer exist (it was probably deleted by hand), so it cannot be uninstalled. Its entry in the list of installed programs is a leftover, and this removes it. No files are deleted.
A backup of the entry (.reg) is saved first in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Caduceus\removed-entries. Double-click it to restore the entry.
programs.backup.step: Saving a backup of the entry
programs.step: Waiting for the uninstaller of {name} to close
notice.program_still_installed: The uninstaller has closed, but the program is still installed. It was cancelled, or it is still finishing in another window: once it is done, open the list again.
notice.uninstall_cancelled: Windows did not give the uninstaller administrator rights, so nothing was uninstalled.
notice.uninstaller_not_opened: Windows could not open the uninstaller of this program. It may have been removed already, or the program registered it incorrectly.
